g.title: Part 7 · Email đổi lịch giao hàng
g.topic: Email about a delayed furniture delivery
g.gist: A furniture company emails a customer to explain a delivery delay and offer two options.
g.vi: Đọc email, chọn đáp án đúng.
g.text:
### Email
To: Priya Sharma <p.sharma@brightlaw.com>
From: Customer Service, Oakline Office Furniture
Date: April 3
Subject: Your order #44817

Dear Ms. Sharma,

Thank you for ordering twelve Alder desks and twelve Ridge chairs for your new office. [1] Unfortunately, our factory in Portland has had a problem with one of its cutting machines, and the desks will not be ready by April 10 as planned. [2]

The chairs are already in our warehouse. We can deliver them on April 10 as scheduled and bring the desks on April 24, at no extra cost. Alternatively, we can deliver the complete order together on April 24. [3]

To apologize for the delay, we would like to offer you a 10 percent discount on the desks. This will be refunded to your credit card once the delivery is complete. [4]

Please reply to this email by April 6 to tell us which option you prefer. If we do not hear from you, we will deliver everything on April 24.

Kind regards,
Marcus Bell
Customer Service Team

groups.inst: Read the email. Choose the best answer to each question.

items.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
o: To explain a delay and offer delivery options
To confirm that an order has been delivered
To advertise a new range of office chairs
To ask Ms. Sharma to pay an overdue bill
items.a: To explain a delay and offer delivery options
items.why_vi: Email báo bàn chưa kịp làm (máy cắt hỏng) và đưa hai cách giao hàng. Đây là câu hỏi mục đích, đọc đoạn đầu và đoạn hai.
items.ev: Unfortunately, our factory in Portland has had a problem with one of its cutting machines, and the desks will not be ready by April 10 as planned.

items.q: What will happen if Ms. Sharma does not reply by April 6?
o: Her order will be canceled.
The chairs will be delivered on April 10.
Everything will be delivered on April 24.
She will lose the 10 percent discount.
items.a: Everything will be delivered on April 24.
items.why_vi: Câu cuối: không trả lời thì giao tất cả ngày 24/4. Bẫy: "April 10" là ngày giao ghế nếu chọn cách thứ nhất.
items.ev: If we do not hear from you, we will deliver everything on April 24.

items.q: What is indicated about the discount?
o: It applies to both desks and chairs.
It will be paid back after delivery.
It must be requested by April 6.
It is offered only to new customers.
items.a: It will be paid back after delivery.
items.why_vi: Khoản giảm 10% chỉ cho bàn và được hoàn vào thẻ sau khi giao xong ("refunded … once the delivery is complete").
items.ev: This will be refunded to your credit card once the delivery is complete.

items.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "We are very sorry for this inconvenience."
items.why_vi: Câu xin lỗi hợp nhất ngay sau tin xấu "bàn không kịp giao ngày 10/4", tức vị trí [2]. Ở [1] chưa có gì để xin lỗi; [3], [4] đã sang chuyện lựa chọn và giảm giá.

g.title: Part 7 · Chuỗi tin nhắn về phòng họp
g.topic: Text-message chain about a meeting room
g.gist: Two colleagues message each other to solve a meeting-room problem before a client visit.
g.vi: Đọc chuỗi tin nhắn, chọn đáp án đúng.
g.text:
### Text-message chain
Helen Wong (9:12 A.M.): Hi Tom, are you in the office yet? The projector in Room 4B isn't working, and the Dalton clients arrive at 10:30.
Tom Baker (9:14 A.M.): I'm on the train, about twenty minutes away. Have you called the IT help desk?
Helen Wong (9:15 A.M.): Yes, but they said a technician can't come until the afternoon.
Tom Baker (9:17 A.M.): OK. Room 2A has a large screen, and I think it's free this morning. Could you check the booking system?
Helen Wong (9:21 A.M.): You're right, nobody has booked it until 1:00. I've reserved it from 10:00 to 12:00.
Tom Baker (9:22 A.M.): Great. Can you ask reception to send the clients to the second floor?
Helen Wong (9:23 A.M.): Leave it to me. I'll also move the coffee and pastries there.
Tom Baker (9:24 A.M.): Thanks, Helen. I'll bring the printed contracts when I arrive.

groups.inst: Read the text-message chain. Choose the best answer to each question.

items.q: Why did Ms. Wong contact Mr. Baker?
o: A piece of equipment is not working.
A client has canceled a meeting.
She cannot find the printed contracts.
The train to the office is late.
items.a: A piece of equipment is not working.
items.why_vi: Tin đầu: máy chiếu phòng 4B hỏng trong khi khách tới lúc 10:30.
items.ev: The projector in Room 4B isn't working, and the Dalton clients arrive at 10:30.

o: It is on the second floor.
It has a broken projector.
It is booked all day.
It is smaller than Room 4B.
items.a: It is on the second floor.
items.why_vi: Tom nhờ lễ tân đưa khách lên tầng hai sau khi đã đặt phòng 2A, nên suy ra phòng 2A ở tầng hai. Đây là câu suy luận, không nói thẳng.
items.ev: Can you ask reception to send the clients to the second floor?

items.q: At 9:23 A.M., what does Ms. Wong most likely mean when she writes, "Leave it to me"?
o: She will speak to reception herself.
She wants Mr. Baker to make the call.
She will leave the office soon.
She does not have time to help.
items.a: She will speak to reception herself.
items.why_vi: "Leave it to me" = cứ để tôi lo. Cô đáp lại lời nhờ báo lễ tân, nên ý là cô sẽ tự báo lễ tân.
items.ev: Helen Wong (9:23 A.M.): Leave it to me.

items.q: What will Mr. Baker bring to the meeting?
o: Coffee and pastries
A new projector
Printed contracts
A booking form
items.why_vi: Tin cuối: Tom sẽ mang hợp đồng đã in. Cà phê và bánh là việc Helen chuyển sang phòng mới.
items.ev: I'll bring the printed contracts when I arrive.

g.title: Part 7 · Thông báo chương trình xe đạp công ty
g.gist: A notice describes a new company program that helps staff buy bicycles and lists its rules.
g.vi: Đọc thông báo, chọn đáp án đúng.
g.text:
### Notice
Ride2Work: New Cycling Program for Staff

From June 1, Corvan Logistics will help employees buy a bicycle for travelling to work. Under the Ride2Work program, the company pays for the bicycle up front, and employees repay the cost through small monthly deductions from their salary over twelve months. There is no interest to pay.

Any permanent employee who has worked for the company for at least six months may apply. Bicycles must be bought from one of our three partner shops, which are listed on the staff website. The maximum value is $1,200, including a helmet and lights.

To help riders, secure bicycle parking has been added in the basement of the Riverside building, and showers are available on the ground floor. Lockers can be requested from the facilities team.

Application forms are available from Human Resources. Completed forms should be returned by May 20. Please note that the program cannot be used to buy electric scooters.

groups.inst: Read the notice. Choose the best answer to each question.

items.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
o: To introduce a program for buying bicycles
To announce the opening of a bicycle shop
To explain new rules for company cars
To invite staff to a cycling competition
items.a: To introduce a program for buying bicycles
items.why_vi: Thông báo giới thiệu chương trình Ride2Work: công ty trả trước tiền xe đạp, nhân viên trả dần.
items.ev: From June 1, Corvan Logistics will help employees buy a bicycle for travelling to work.

items.q: The word "secure" in paragraph 3, line 1, is closest in meaning to
o: safe
certain
fixed
confident
items.why_vi: "secure bicycle parking" = chỗ để xe an toàn (không bị mất). "certain" là chắc chắn, "confident" là tự tin, không hợp với chỗ để xe.
items.ev: To help riders, secure bicycle parking has been added in the basement of the Riverside building, and showers are available on the ground floor.

items.q: What is NOT mentioned as part of the program?
o: Payments are spread over a year.
Employees pay no interest.
Bicycles must come from partner shops.
The company provides free bicycle repairs.
items.a: The company provides free bicycle repairs.
items.why_vi: Câu NOT: ba ý kia đều có trong bài (trả trong 12 tháng, không lãi, mua ở cửa hàng đối tác). Sửa xe miễn phí không được nhắc.

items.q: Who can apply for the program?
o: Permanent staff with at least six months of service
Any employee who already owns a bicycle
Only staff working in the Riverside building
Temporary workers who live near the office
items.a: Permanent staff with at least six months of service
items.why_vi: Đoạn hai: nhân viên chính thức đã làm ít nhất sáu tháng được đăng ký.
items.ev: Any permanent employee who has worked for the company for at least six months may apply.
